rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for commendation or favourable words.

example.english: Everyone had nothing but praise for the food at this restaurant.
example.traditional: 大家都稱讚呢間餐廳啲嘢食好有水準。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 cing1 zaan3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 jau5 seoi2 zeon2

rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for praising someone or something.

example.english: I really praise you for doing a great job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 zaan3 nei5 zou6 dak1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when you want to make the act of commending someone explicit rather than using the shorter 讚.

example.english: The boss used the meeting to praise me for handling it well.
example.traditional: 老闆喺會上稱讚我處理得好。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 hai2 wui6 soeng6 cing1 zaan3 ngo5 cyu5 lei5 dak1 hou2

rows.note: Use this especially for glorifying or worshipping a deity, or for elevated praise.

example.english: The church came together to praise God.
example.jyutping: gaau3 wui2 jat1 cai4 zaan3 mei5 soeng6 dai3

rows.note: Use this for praise or glorification directed toward God or another object of worship.

example.english: Everyone joined in praise of God through hymns at church.
example.traditional: 教會入面，大家一齊用詩歌讚美上帝。
example.jyutping: gaau3 wui6 jap6 min6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 jung6 si1 go1 zaan3 mei5 soeng6 dai3
